title: [LOGGED IN] Logged-in Store starts with the "Special offers" carousel and its arrows work

steps.saw: Store page loaded with cookie banner

steps.text: If a cookie banner is shown, click Dismiss. If a Login successful popup is shown, click Ok.
steps.saw: Clicked Dismiss. No Login successful popup.

steps.text: Does the header show the green "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button, and no "Login" button?
steps.saw: Green Player{TEST_USER_ID} button, balances 0 and 40, no Login

steps.text: Is the "Special offers" heading the first section of the Store page?
steps.saw: 'Special offers' heading is first, above the 'Store' heading

steps.text: Is the "Small welcome bundle" card shown with "Available: 1/1" and a green USD price button?
steps.saw: Small welcome bundle, Available: 1/1, green button USD 5.40 (5.99 struck out)

steps.text: Click the "Next offer" arrow next to the card. Do not click the price button.
Is the "Medium welcome bundle" card now shown?
steps.saw: Medium welcome bundle card shown, Available: 1/1, USD 54.00

steps.text: Is the "Small welcome bundle" card shown again?
steps.saw: Small welcome bundle card shown again
